newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil soybean plantings 10 pct to Oct 31 -Safras.
newsitem.headline: Brazil soybean plantings 10 pct to Oct 31 -Safras.

text.p: Brazilian soybean plantings were 10 percent completed by October 31 against eight percent by the same stage last year and an average of 10 percent in the past five years, consultants Safras e Mercado said.
According to Safras, the weather conditions have improved in practically all producing regions, making work in the field easier.
Planting is at its most advanced stage in Parana, expected to be the largest producing state this year, where plantings are 15 percent done against an historical average of 14 percent.
As of October 24, plantings had totalled two percent against six percent completed both at the same stage the previous year and the historical average.
-- Caroline Bulloch, Rio de Janeiro newsroom, 5521 5074151
